Drones: two per attacker, any damage but a fall destroys one, a jump every 3 s, strafing at full speed (verified); the speed, acceleration, air control, jump height, boost numbers, size, the height of a step it climbs, its view (field and tilt), where its camera sits, the throw and the pickup reach are placeholders. Default cameras: their turn limits, speed and field of view are placeholders. Scans: a 1 s hold (verified), the cone a placeholder. Pings: their time, cooldown and count are placeholders. The Bulletproof Camera: one each, a 0.75 m EMP dart and 10 s of signal outdoors (verified); the dart's recharge and how long it disables are placeholders. Metres, seconds, degrees.
